quantizer_selection: The registered seven-threshold pool has exactly one three-bit partition; shared by both methods, no quantizer search freedom.
dictionary_rule: Compare exact stepwise greedy up to eight configurations with the deduplicated eight-bin population winners dictionary; select only by construction800 expected quality.
greedy: First maximize population expected quality across all bins; then maximize exact mean source-bin marginal improvement. Stop at nonpositive gain. Lazy evaluation uses previous marginal gains only as diminishing-return upper bounds, preserving exhaustive greedy choices.
profile_tie_rule: Lexicographic stable profile ID flat_{frozen_catalogue_ordinal:07d}_{configuration_SHA}; ordinal follows deterministic complete-catalogue order.
dictionary_tie_rule: Construction mean, then fewer profiles, then sorted stable profile IDs.
candidate_scope: All existing exact G1 layouts, and G2 complete-prefix plus exact suffix layouts with both received states in frozen Q and total body <=924. All feasible original4041+15 profiles must be contained. No new body length or new packet-count family.
source_split: Original C/SOURCE_SPLIT seed2026100501; verify exact original split asset. Internal200 has already been used for exploration and is not a holdout.
source_information: Source image, average SNR and observed quantized CSI bin only; choose one whole public profile after integrating uncertainty within that bin. No true h, noise, labels or actual decoder outcomes.
receiver_profile_information: At most eight selected public configurations per method/SNR are pre-agreed; paid first12-bit header carries actual profile ID. No source-ID or simulator object is passed to receiver.
channel: Rayleigh CN(0,1), same h for header and every body group, conditionally independent packet noise given h.
pilot_feedback_scope: Paid equivalent symbol costs with ideal receiver/feedback CSI and reliable quantized feedback; no pilot-estimation error or reverse-link simulation.
16QAM_energy: Equal constellation-average energy; not per-frame equal energy.
main_system_relationship: Separate DROP G1/G2 model extension; not automatically the final single-group main protocol or KEEP model.
partial_order: Original entropy-order quality assets; no relabeling to raster and no claim of actual selected-position availability.
primary_interpolation: linear in dB with constant endpoint tails
quadrature_diagnostic: Same selected profiles and same frozen source-bin profile choices; no reselection.
sensitivity_scope: Fixed-policy model-assumption stress cases, not confidence bounds. Low-tail replacement applies below each physical packet curve's first measured SNR. Upper tail still uses the final measured endpoint and is explicitly unvalidated.
gate_interpretation: Engineering screening only; report if passing depends on interpolation/tail assumptions. No automatic asset or real-link expansion even if the primary gate passes.
bootstrap_scope: Paired source variation conditional on frozen model; excludes PHY table/selection uncertainty.
